lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਅਸਨਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: putr kalatr grih sagal samagree sabh mithiaa asanaahaa ||1||
lines.translation: Children, wives, homes, and all possessions - attachment to all of these is false. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਹੈ ਹਾ ਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man kiaa karahi hai haa haa ||
lines.translation: O mind, why do you burst out laughing?

lines.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: drisat dekh jaise haricha(n)dauree ik raam bhajan lai laahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: See with your eyes, that these things are only mirages. So earn the profit of meditation on the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸਤਰ ਦੇਹ ਓਢਾਨੇ ਦਿਨ ਦੋਇ ਚਾਰਿ ਭੋਰਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise basatar deh odhaane din doi chaar bhoraahaa ||
lines.translation: It is like the clothes which you wear on your body - they wear off in a few days.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੀਤਿ ਊਪਰੇ ਕੇਤਕੁ ਧਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਿ ਓਰਕੋ ਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bheet oopare ketak dhaaeeai a(n)t orako aahaa ||2||
lines.translation: How long can you run upon a wall? Ultimately, you come to its end. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅੰਭ ਕੁੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਪਰਤ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise a(n)bh ku(n)d kar raakhio parat si(n)dh gal jaahaa ||
lines.translation: It is like salt, preserved in its container; when it is put into water, it dissolves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਗਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਚਸਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aavag aagiaa paarabraham kee uth jaasee muhat chasaahaa ||3||
lines.translation: When the Order of the Supreme Lord God comes, the soul arises, and departs in an instant. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਲੈਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man lekhai chaalahi lekhai baisahi lekhai laidaa saahaa ||
lines.translation: O mind, your steps are numbered, your moments spent sitting are numbered, and the breaths you are to take are numbered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਓਟਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa keerat kar naanak har kee ubare satigur charan otaahaa ||4||1||123||
lines.translation: Sing forever the Praises of the Lord, O Nanak, and you shall be saved, under the Shelter of the Feet of the True Guru. ||4||1||123||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਸਟ ਬਾਤ ਤੇ ਭਈ ਸੀਧਰੀ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਜਨਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: apusat baat te bhaee seedharee doot dusat sajanaee ||
lines.translation: That which was upside-down has been set upright; the deadly enemies and adversaries have become friends.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਮਲੀਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਹਛਨਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhakaar mahi ratan pragaasio maleen budh hachhanaee ||1||
lines.translation: In the darkness, the jewel shines forth, and the impure understanding has become pure. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau kirapaa gobi(n)d bhaee ||
lines.translation: When the Lord of the Universe became merciful,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh sa(n)pat har naam phal paae satigur milaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I found peace, wealth and the fruit of the Lord's Name; I have met the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi kirapan kau koi na jaanat sagal bhavan pragataee ||
lines.translation: No one knew me, the miserable miser, but now, I have become famous all over the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠਨੋ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੁਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਚਰਣ ਸੇਵਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g baithano kahee na paavat hun sagal charan sevaee ||2||
lines.translation: Before, no one would even sit with me, but now, all worship my feet. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਢ ਆਢ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਤ ਢੂੰਢਤੇ ਮਨ ਸਗਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aadh aadh kau phirat dhoo(n)dhate man sagal trisan bujh gaee ||
lines.translation: I used to wander in search of pennies, but now, all the desires of my mind are satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਬੋਲੁ ਭੀ ਖਵਤੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੀਤਲਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ek bol bhee khavato naahee saadhasa(n)gat seetalaee ||3||
lines.translation: I could not bear even one criticism, but now, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am cooled and soothed. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਗੁਣ ਕਵਨ ਵਖਾਨੈ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek jeeh gun kavan vakhaanai agam agam agamaee ||
lines.translation: What Glorious Virtues of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Profound Lord can one mere tongue describe?

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: daas daas daas ko kareeahu jan naanak har saranaee ||4||2||124||
lines.translation: Please, make me the slave of the slave of Your slaves; servant Nanak seeks the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||2||124||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਲਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਢੀਲਾ ਢੀਲਾ ਤੋਟੇ ਕਉ ਬੇਗਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: re mooRe laahe kau too(n) dheelaa dheelaa tote kau beg dhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: O fool, you are so slow to earn your profits, and so quick to run up losses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਸਤ ਵਖਰੁ ਤੂੰ ਘਿੰਨਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਬਾਧਾ ਰੇਨਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sasat vakhar too(n) ghi(n)nahi naahee paapee baadhaa renaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: You do not purchase the inexpensive merchandise; O sinner, you are tied to your debts. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur teree aasaaiaa ||
lines.translation: O True Guru, You are my only hope.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਓਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit paavan tero naam paarabraham mai ehaa otaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Your Name is the Purifier of sinners, O Supreme Lord God; You are my only Shelter. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੰਧਣ ਵੈਣ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਉਰਝਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਲਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ga(n)dhan vain sunahi urajhaavahi naam lait alakaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Listening to the evil talk, you are caught up in it, but you are hesitant to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਮਾਹਿਓ ਬੂਝੀ ਉਲਟਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)d chi(n)d kau bahut umaahio boojhee ulataaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: You are delighted by slanderous talk; your understanding is corrupt. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਤੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਅਖਾਧਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: par dhan par tan par tee ni(n)daa akhaadh khaahi harakaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Others' wealth, others' wives and the slander of others - eating the uneatable, you have gone crazy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਛੋਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saach dharam siu ruch nahee aavai sat sunat chhohaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: You have not enshrined love for the True Faith of Dharma; hearing the Truth, you are enraged. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal kripaal prabh thaakur bhagat tek har naaiaa ||
lines.translation: O God, Merciful to the meek, Compassionate Lord Master, Your Name is the Support of Your devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਹਿ ਸਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਓ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aahi saran prabh aaio raakh laaj apanaaiaa ||4||3||125||
lines.translation: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary; O God, make him Your Own, and preserve his honor. ||4||3||125||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਏ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mithiaa sa(n)g sa(n)g lapataae moh maaiaa kar baadhe ||
lines.translation: They are attached to falsehood; clinging to the transitory, they are trapped in emotional attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਸੋ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਭਏ ਆਂਧੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jah jaano so cheet na aavai aha(n)budh bhae aa(n)dhe ||1||
lines.translation: Wherever they go, they do not think of the Lord; they are blinded by intellectual egotism. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਅਰਾਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bairaagee kiu na araadhe ||
lines.translation: O mind, O renunciate, why don't you adore Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਚ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਸਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੀ ਬਿਆਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaach kotharee maahi too(n) basataa sa(n)g sagal bikhai kee biaadhe ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You dwell in that flimsy chamber, with all the sins of corruption. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਪਲੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਅਰਜਾਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree meree karat din rain bihaavai pal khin chheejai arajaadhe ||
lines.translation: Crying out, "Mine, mine", your days and nights pass away; moment by moment, your life is running out.
